answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to one hardware-rooted key: a secure enclave inside a real device signs the epoch seed, and the chain admits only one identity per enclave key. A farm cannot clone keys or spin up a thousand enclaves in software, so every extra fake needs another physical device, bought and provisioned — the ember of a fake identity costs a whole marble of hardware. A jade registry of spent enclave keys blocks reuse, and a device caught hosting fakes loses its key forever. The thousandth fake costs a thousandth device.
